projects.name: sentoarc
projects.summary: Validates and auto-fixes SCORM packages exported from SAP Enable Now (SEN) so they import cleanly into WalkMe Learning Arc (SCORM 1.2 only).

projects.name: Chartwright
projects.description: Drop a spreadsheet. Get a dashboard.
projects.summary: Chartwright turns an Excel, CSV or JSON file into an interactive dashboard in seconds. It reads your columns, works out which are dates, numbers and categories, and builds key figures and charts automatically. You can then filter, add your own charts, and share the result as a PDF, a data file or an email.
